outcome: The catalogue listing returns one page at a time.

acceptance_criteria.text: listItems returns 20 items by default and reports the total.

expected_verification.assertion: the default call returns 20 items and a total of 60

acceptance_criteria.text: A requested page returns the items at that offset.
A page size outside 1..100 is clamped rather than honoured.

expected_verification.assertion: page sizes of 5000 and 0 clamp to 100 and 1
